description: Allow finalizing receipt/tax documents. MUST remain false until accountant verifies templates, VAT rate, numbering, and any Tax Authority requirements.
Show the Financial Documents ingestion page (Phase 3 feature).
Show the Agent Control Center page (Phase 4 feature).
Show the personal Saved Views bar on /my-jobs, /clients, and /billing. Phase 2 §4.2 — personal scope only; team-shared scope is Phase 3.
Allow users to mark saved views as team-shared (visible to all logged-in users on the matching scope). When off, the UI hides the toggle and the API rejects visibility=team with 400. Phase 3 §5.8.
Show search scope chips and the /search results page. The /api/search endpoint stays callable so a power-user URL still works.
Show the notification bell in the header and write notification rows from triggers (job assigned, mention, SLA breach). Admin enables when the surface is ready for the pilot.
Open /statistics/me for employees and show the 'My Statistics' sidebar link. Phase 2 §4.5 - personal self-view scoped to the caller's jobs.

Render the new Overview/Timeline/Related/Files tab layout on /my-jobs/[id], plus the admin reassign control and inline active-timer panel. Phase 2 §4.6. When off, the legacy single-page layout renders unchanged.
Show the 4-bucket AR aging strip (0-30 / 31-60 / 61-90 / 91+) on /billing and on the admin dashboard, with bucket click-through filtering. Phase 2 §4.3.
Show hourly-bank burn-rate (projected months remaining) on each bank in the client billing tab, and the admin dashboard 'Hourly banks low' strip. Phase 2 §4.4.

Run the SLA breach scan cron and write one sla_breached notification per breached job. Off by default until the pilot operator confirms current SLA targets and is ready to receive alerts. Phase 3 §5.1.
Enable the recurring job template surface (admin tab) and the nightly cron writer that generates Jobs from due templates. Phase 3 §5.5.
Show the Knowledge area (/knowledge), sidebar link, and global-search Knowledge scope. When off, all /api/knowledge and /knowledge routes return 404 and the search bucket is excluded. Phase 3 §5.6.

Compute and store weekly per-client health snapshots (open / delayed jobs, hours consumed, outstanding payments, projected hourly-bank months) and show the Health tab on client detail. The /api/cron/client-health writer no-ops when off. Phase 3 §5.7.
S3-backed attachment upload + presigned URLs. Default off. Enable per ring when storage is provisioned.
When true AND receipt_finalize_enabled=true AND env ALLOW_PRODUCTION_ISSUANCE=true, the PDF renderer omits the DRAFT watermark. Default false.

Enable the AI structuring step on knowledge articles. Default off. Even when true, the real LLM call only fires if ALLOW_KNOWLEDGE_AI env is set AND knowledge_ai_provider_verified flag is true; otherwise the step runs deterministic dry-run.
Set true ONLY after a vendor + redaction review. Required (along with knowledge_ai_structuring_enabled and ALLOW_KNOWLEDGE_AI env) for the real LLM call path to engage.
